rationale: Adds a persisted Device settings tap action and changes View right click from HA more-info to the existing House Plan device editor. The owner selected permission-hint-only denial for non-writers and kiosk. This is a new visible capability and gesture contract without a data model migration.

summary.ru: Настройки устройства открываются из просмотра действием по нажатию или правым кликом при праве редактирования вне киоска.
summary.en: Device settings open from View by tap action or right click for a House Plan writer outside kiosk.
